cases.architecture: Nuxt 4 application whose API is Nitro server routes under server/api (defineEventHandler), with Drizzle ORM over Postgres as the data layer, ioredis for short-lived share tokens, and the portal session resolved into event.context.session by server middleware.
cases.why: The same short-lived Redis share token, but mintShareToken draws 32 bytes from node:crypto randomBytes and stores the payload under a SHA-256 digest of the token with a TTL, and consumeShareToken redeems it once via getdel, so the token cannot be predicted from a timestamp.
